*The objective of this script is to (i) make natal assignments to Battle Creek spawners using Sr isotope and TE models, and (ii) estimate population composition through bootstrapping*

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
rm(list = ls()) #clean the environment

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, eval = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# wrangling
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
library(here)
library(readxl)

# classification
library(tidymodels)
library(caret)

library(ranger)

# plotting
library(patchwork)
library(ggalluvial)
library(scico)
library(RColorBrewer)

# set colors
# colors <- c("SAC" = "#FF7F00", "CNH" = "#FDBF6F", "BAT" = "#B15928",
#             "MIL" =  "#FFD92F", "DEE" = "#B3B3B3", "BUT" = "#FC8D62",
#             "FEA" = "#E31A1C", "FEH" =  "#FB9A99", "YUB" = "#E78AC3",
#             "AME" = "#6A3D9A", "NIH" = "#CAB2D6", "MOK" = "#1F78B4",
#             "MOH" = "#A6CEE3", "STA" = "cyan4", "TUO" =  "#8DD3C7",

# set colors
brewer.pal("Set3", n = 12)

# setting colors only for sources predicted for Battle adults (not all sources)
colors <- c("BAT" = "#8DD3C7", "CNH" = "#B3DE69", "DEE" = "#BEBADA", "MIL" = "#FB8072", "SAC" = "#80B1D3", "BUT" = "#FDB462",
            "FEH" = "#FFFFB3", "NIH" = "#FCCDE5", "MOK" = "#D9D9D9", "MOH" = "#BC80BD", "STA" = "#CCEBC5", "TUO" = "#FFED6F")


# define fixed source order
source_order <- c("BAT", "CNH", "DEE", "MIL", "SAC", "BUT", "FEA", "FEH", "YUB", "AME", "NIH", "MOK", "MOH", "STA", "TUO", "MER", "MEH")

# defince reverse source order
source_order_rev <- rev(c("BAT", "CNH", "DEE", "MIL", "SAC", "BUT", "FEA", "FEH", "YUB", "AME", "NIH", "MOK", "MOH", "STA", "TUO", "MER", "MEH"))

#Set which sources to consider for the model
sources <- c("BAT","DEE","MIL","SAC","BUT","CNH")
```

# Prepare data

Load unknown Battle adult samples

```{r}
#load unknown origin BAT fish
fish_read <- read.csv(here('data','battle_data.csv')) 

# look at data structure
glimpse(fish_read)

# unique number of samples
length(unique(fish_read$lab_id))
```

Spline Sr values for every 10 um

```{r}
# Source spline function that will work within dplyr environments
source(here('data','function_spline.R'))

# define x vector to predict Sr values to (didn't start at zero bc missing data for some otos,
# and some are spring & winter run so their core values will be lower and could result in misclassifying fall run from that stream)
min_x = 100; max_x = 320; N_cols = 23
(x_vec <- seq(min_x, max_x, length.out = N_cols)) # predict values every 10um

# Create loop to fit spine to Sr8786 data, then predict a value for each x vector distance
predictedSr = NULL

FishID <- unique(fish_read$lab_id)

for (i in 1:length(FishID)) {
  X <- as.data.frame(subset(fish_read, fish_read$lab_id==FishID[i]))     # subset data for first fish
  oto_spl <- spline.fun(X, xvar = "Distance_um", yvar = "sr_spline", df = nrow(X)-1) # run function varying df by fish (as differing lengths)
  Pred_Sr <- predict(oto_spl,x_vec)$y # Predict a Sr8786 value for every x vector distance
  temp_df <- data.frame(lab_id = FishID[i], Distance_um = x_vec, Pred_Sr = Pred_Sr)
  predictedSr <- rbind(predictedSr, temp_df)   #bind new df to the end of existing df
}

#nat_loc <- adult %>% distinct(Sample_ID, NAT_LOC)
#predictedSr <- left_join(predictedSr, nat_loc)

##-------------------------------------------------------
# CREATE DF FOR MODEL (ADD IN PREDICTED SR VALUES IN A ROW PER FISH)

predictedSr$Distance_um = format(predictedSr$Distance_um, digits=3) #limit to 3 digits or the col headers are nuts!

predictedSr$XDistance_um = paste0("X",predictedSr$Distance_um)
predictedSr$Distance_um = NULL

fish_wide <- tidyr::spread(predictedSr, XDistance_um, Pred_Sr) ##Change to wide format, so 1 fish per row

# add metadata to wide format
fish_wide <- fish_wide %>% 
  left_join(fish_read %>% distinct(lab_id), by = c("lab_id"))

# format to long format for plotting
fish_long <- fish_wide %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("X"),
    names_to = "Distance_um",
    names_prefix = "X",
    values_to = "Sr8786"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(Distance_um = as.numeric(Distance_um))
```

Now calculate post-splined Sr raster values - Sr median, min, max, range - this is to apply the feature extraction model.

```{r}
# assign otolith region
fish_long <- fish_long %>%
    mutate(natal = case_when(
      Distance_um >= 245 & Distance_um <=320   ~ "y", TRUE ~ NA),
           late_core_natal = case_when(Distance_um > 160  ~ "y",
                                       TRUE ~ NA))
  
# automated median
median_auto <- fish_long %>%
  filter(natal == "y") %>%
    group_by(lab_id) %>% 
  summarize(med_sr_auto = median(Sr8786, na.rm = T))
  
# automated raster
raster_auto <- fish_long %>%
    filter(late_core_natal=="y") %>%
  group_by(lab_id) %>%
    summarize(min_sr_auto = min(Sr8786, na.rm = T),
           max_sr_auto = max(Sr8786, na.rm = T)) %>%
    mutate(range_sr_auto = max_sr_auto - min_sr_auto) 

# add raster Sr values
fish_wide <- fish_wide %>% 
  left_join(raster_auto, by = c("lab_id" = "lab_id")) %>% 
  left_join(median_auto, by = c("lab_id" = "lab_id"))


glimpse(fish_wide)

```

Load the natal mean TE values and exogenous feeding scores

```{r}
#read in te natal values
te_natal_read <-read.csv(here('outputs','TE_natal_srba.csv'),  stringsAsFactors = F)

glimpse(te_natal_read)

# modify columns
te_natal <- te_natal_read %>%
  mutate(lab_id = Fish_ID)%>%
  filter(Lifestage == "adult") %>% 
  dplyr::select(lab_id, Sr_Ca, Ba_Ca)

#read in exog scores
exog_readin <- read_excel(here('data','battle_creek_exog_scores.xlsx'), sheet = "exog")%>%
  dplyr::select(lab_id, mean_exog = exog_score)

# join with full data
fish_mod <- fish_wide %>% 
  left_join(te_natal, by="lab_id") %>%
  left_join(exog_readin, by="lab_id") %>% 
  
  # fill missing mean exog scores
  mutate(#model_use = "X320",
         mean_exog = case_when(
           is.na(mean_exog) ~ 1.5,
           TRUE ~ mean_exog
         ))

glimpse(fish_mod)
```

# Natal assignment

## Sr time series assignment

Load the natal assignment models trained in the prior script

```{r}
# Sr isotope ts model
final_rf_fit <- readRDS(here('outputs','final_sr_ts_model_2025-11-06.rds'))
```

Predict adult origin using Sr isotope time series model

```{r}
# predict
set.seed(123)
pred_ts <- fish_mod %>% 
  bind_cols(predict(final_rf_fit, ., type = "class"),
            predict(final_rf_fit, ., type = "prob")) %>% 
  
  # rename .pred* columns by appending "_te"
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_sr"), starts_with(".pred"))
```

## Trace element

```{r}
# trace element model
final_rf_fit_te <- readRDS(here('outputs','final_te_model_2025-11-06.rds'))
```

```{r}
# predict!
set.seed(1234)
pred_te <- fish_mod %>% 
  
  # drop fish with NA in Sr Ca, otherwise all will be assinged to BUT!
  drop_na(Sr_Ca, Ba_Ca) %>% 
  
  bind_cols(predict(final_rf_fit_te, ., type = "class"),
            predict(final_rf_fit_te, ., type = "prob")) %>% 
  
  # rename .pred* columns by appending "_te"
  rename_with(~ paste0(.x, "_te"), starts_with(".pred"))

glimpse(pred_te)
```

## Post-hoc multiplier

Now combine the posterior probs

```{r}
# Merge the two prediction tables
pred_combined <- pred_ts %>%
  dplyr::select(lab_id, starts_with(".pred_"), starts_with("X"), mean_exog) %>%
  left_join(
    pred_te %>%
      dplyr::select(lab_id, starts_with(".pred_"), Sr_Ca, Ba_Ca), by = "lab_id"
  )


# Use te_missing_if_any = TRUE  => fallback to Sr if ANY of the TE probs are NA (default below)
# Use te_missing_if_any = FALSE => fallback only if ALL TE probs are NA
te_missing_if_any <- TRUE

# ---- compute posteriors----
pred_post <- pred_combined %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    
    # grab sr and te vectors for the chosen sources as list-columns
    sr_vec = list(c_across(all_of(paste0(".pred_", sources, "_sr")))),
    te_vec = list(c_across(all_of(paste0(".pred_", sources, "_te")))),
    
    # decide whether the TE prediction should be considered missing
    te_missing = if (te_missing_if_any) any(is.na(unlist(te_vec))) else all(is.na(unlist(te_vec))),
    
    # normalize sr probs (guard against zero / all-NA)
    sr_sum = sum(unlist(sr_vec), na.rm = TRUE),
    sr_norm = list(
      if (is.na(sr_sum) || sr_sum == 0) rep(1/length(unlist(sr_vec)), length(unlist(sr_vec)))
      else unlist(sr_vec) / sr_sum
    ),
    
    # compute raw posterior = sr_norm * te_vec, but only when TE is present
    post_raw = list(
      if (te_missing) rep(NA_real_, length(unlist(sr_vec))) 
      else unlist(sr_norm) * unlist(te_vec)
    ),
    
    # normalize posterior
    post_sum = sum(unlist(post_raw), na.rm = TRUE),
    post_norm = list(
      if (is.na(post_sum) || post_sum == 0) rep(NA_real_, length(unlist(sr_vec)))
      else unlist(post_raw) / post_sum
    ),
    
    # final class with fallback
    .pred_class_final = if (te_missing || all(is.na(unlist(post_norm)))) {
      .pred_class_sr
    } else {
      # if sr_class is NOT one of the allowed sources, stick with sr_class
      if (!(.pred_class_sr %in% sources)) {
        .pred_class_sr
      } else {
        sources[which.max(unlist(post_norm))]
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    post_norm_named = map(post_norm, ~ set_names(as.numeric(.x), paste0("post_norm_post", sources)))
  ) %>%
  unnest_wider(post_norm_named) %>%
  dplyr::select(-sr_vec, -te_vec, -sr_sum, -post_raw, -post_sum, -post_norm)

# example rows where TE was missing and fallback applied
pred_post %>% filter(te_missing) %>% dplyr::select(lab_id, .pred_class_sr, .pred_class_te, .pred_class_final) %>% head(10)

#-----------------------
# finalize probabilities 
#-----------------------

pred_final <- pred_post %>%
  
  relocate(.pred_class_final, .after = .pred_class_te) %>% 
  relocate(.pred_class_sr, .before = .pred_class_te) %>% 
  
  # calculate maximum sr ts model prob
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(max_prob_sr = max(c_across(.pred_AME_sr:.pred_YUB_sr)),
         max_prob_te = max(c_across(.pred_BAT_te:.pred_SAC_te)),
         max_prob_final = max(c_across(post_norm_postBAT:post_norm_postCNH))) %>% 
  
  # relocate
  relocate(max_prob_sr, .before = .pred_class_sr) %>% 
  relocate(max_prob_te, .after = max_prob_sr) %>% 
  relocate(max_prob_final, .after = max_prob_te) %>% 
  relocate(te_missing, .before = max_prob_sr) %>%
  
   # make factor ordering consistent
  mutate(
    .pred_class_sr    = factor(.pred_class_sr,    levels = source_order),
    .pred_class_te    = factor(.pred_class_te,    levels = source_order),
    .pred_class_final = factor(.pred_class_final, levels = source_order),
    #NAT_LOC = factor(NAT_LOC, levels = source_order)
  ) %>% 
  ungroup()
  
glimpse(pred_final)
```

Double check to see if post-hoc multiplier correctly applied

```{r}
# adjust columns
pred_final <- pred_final %>% 
  mutate(
    .pred_class_sr    = factor(.pred_class_sr,    levels = source_order),
    .pred_class_te    = factor(.pred_class_te,    levels = source_order),
    .pred_class_final = factor(.pred_class_final, levels = source_order))

# function to compute manual posterior for one row
check_posteriors <- function(row, sources) {
  sr_vec <- as.numeric(row %>% dplyr::select(paste0(".pred_", sources, "_sr")))
  te_vec <- as.numeric(row %>% dplyr::select(paste0(".pred_", sources, "_te")))
  
  # normalize sr
  sr_norm <- sr_vec / sum(sr_vec, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # compute posterior
  post_raw <- sr_norm * te_vec
  post_norm <- post_raw / sum(post_raw, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # stored posterior from table
  stored_post <- row %>% dplyr::select(paste0("post_norm_post", sources)) %>% as.numeric()
  
  tibble(
    lab_id = row$lab_id,
    source = sources,
    sr_norm = sr_norm,
    te_vec = te_vec,
    post_raw = post_raw,
    post_norm_calc = post_norm,
    post_norm_stored = stored_post
  )
}

# Example: check first 3 individuals
posterior_checks <- purrr::map_dfr(1:10, ~ check_posteriors(pred_final[.x, ], sources))

posterior_checks

```

Note that for some individuals, posterior probs for some sources could be chosen even when that source for sr or te was low!
For example, "SC_05_50015E" was assigned SAC, because high probs for either sr or te models were canceled out because either had a zero prob.

```{r}
# Predicted probabilities
pred_viz <- pred_final %>%
  select(lab_id,
         starts_with(".pred_") 
         ) %>%
  select(-.pred_class_sr, -.pred_class_te, -.pred_class_final, -.pred_AME_sr, -.pred_NIH_sr, -.pred_FEA_sr, -.pred_FEH_sr, -.pred_MEH_sr, -.pred_MER_sr, -.pred_MOH_sr, -.pred_MOK_sr,  -.pred_STA_sr, -.pred_TUO_sr, -.pred_YUB_sr) %>% 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(lab_id),
    names_to = c("source","type"),
    names_pattern = "\\.pred_([A-Z]+)_(sr|te)",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) #%>%
  #mutate(type = toupper(type))  # optional

# Posterior probabilities
post_viz <- pred_final %>%
  select(lab_id, starts_with("post_norm_post")) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -c(lab_id),
    names_to = "source",
    names_pattern = "post_norm_post([A-Z]+)",
    values_to = "prob"
  ) %>%
  mutate(type = "Posterior")

# Combine
viz_data <- bind_rows(pred_viz, post_viz)



# Example visualization for a subset of individuals
viz_data %>% filter(lab_id %in% unique(pred_final$lab_id)[1:5]) %>% 
  mutate(type = factor(type, levels = c("sr", "te", "Posterior"))) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = source, y = prob, fill = type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8), width = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ lab_id, ncol = 3) +
  labs(
    title = "Comparison of SR, TE, and Posterior Probabilities by Source",
    x = "Source",
    y = "Probability",
    fill = "Probability Type"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

```

# Winter-run removal and CWT

*Updated 2026-01-15*

```{r}
# read in final predictions (N = 287) - this includes CWT and winter-run
pred_final_read <- read.csv(here('outputs', 'battle_adult_assign.csv'))

glimpse(pred_final_read)

# number of runs
pred_final_read %>% 
  group_by(year, run) %>% 
  tally()

# remove winter-run (n = 14) - N = 273 
pred_final_filter <- pred_final_read %>% 
  filter(!run == "winter")


```

Natal origin re-assignment based on adipose fin status and CWT information

Rules:
For fish with CWT info available (n = 19), use CWT-origin instead of otolith origin (this includes n = 16 adipose absent + n = 3 adipose unknown status)
For all other fish (including adipose absent fish without CWT info or adipose unknown status fish), use otolith origin
For adipose absent fish without CWT into (n = 5) that was otolith assigned to a wild source, assign as "UNK".

```{r}
# read in RMIS data
rmis_readin <-read.csv(here('data','CSV19422.csv'),  stringsAsFactors = F)

# select columns
rmis <-rmis_readin %>%
  dplyr::select(tag_code = tag_code_or_release_id, brood_year, hatchery_location_name)


#Read in additional data from USFW for Battle Creek
#bc_usfw <-read_excel(here('data','Battle_Creek_otoliths_USFWS_sub.xlsx'), sheet="overview")

# join with prediction
pred_final_filter <- pred_final_filter %>% 
  left_join(rmis, by = c("cwt_no" = "tag_code")) %>% 
  
  relocate(brood_year, hatchery_location_name, .after = cwt_no)

# number of adipose fin absent fish - n = 21 - note that n = 5 adipose fin absent fish have no CWT info
pred_final_filter %>% 
  filter(adipose_fin == "absent") %>% 
  dplyr::select(lab_id, adipose_fin, cwt_no, hatchery_location_name, .pred_class_final)

# number of CWT info fish n = 19 (includes adipose absent n = 16 and unknown n = 3)
pred_final_filter %>% 
  filter(!(is.na(cwt_no) | cwt_no == "NTD")) %>% 
  dplyr::select(lab_id, adipose_fin, cwt_no, hatchery_location_name, .pred_class_final)

# check unique CWT hatchery - only feather river hatchery
unique(pred_final_filter$hatchery_location_name)

# now make new column with natal assignments replaced with CWT assignments
# set wild sources
wild_source <- c("BAT", "DEE", "MIL", "SAC", "BUT", "FEA", "YUB", "AME", "MOK", "STA", "TUO", "MER")

pred_final_filter <- pred_final_filter %>% 
  # update otolith assignment with CWT
  mutate(.pred_class_final_cwt = case_when(hatchery_location_name == "FEATHER R HATCHERY" ~ "FEH",
                                           TRUE ~ .pred_class_final)) %>% 
  
  # for adipose_fin == "absent" & .pred_class_final_cwt == wild source, then change assignment to "UNK"
  mutate(.pred_class_final_cwt = case_when(adipose_fin == "absent" & .pred_class_final_cwt %in% wild_source ~ "UNK",
                                           TRUE ~ .pred_class_final_cwt)) %>% 
  # relocate
  relocate(.pred_class_final_cwt, .after = .pred_class_final)

# check adipose absent fish natal assignment
pred_final_filter %>% 
  filter(adipose_fin == "absent") %>% 
  dplyr::select(lab_id, adipose_fin, cwt_no, hatchery_location_name, .pred_class_final, .pred_class_final_cwt)

pred_final_filter %>% 
  filter(adipose_fin == "unknown" & !is.na(cwt_no) ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(lab_id, adipose_fin, cwt_no, hatchery_location_name, .pred_class_final, .pred_class_final_cwt)

# for CWT fish how many matched otolith assignments? %agreement: 63% (12/19)
pred_final_filter %>%
  filter(!is.na(hatchery_location_name)) %>%
  summarise(
    matched = sum(.pred_class_final == .pred_class_final_cwt, na.rm = TRUE),
    total = n(),
    percent_matched = matched / total * 100
  )

# check how many samples were re-assigned - n = 8
pred_final_filter %>%
  summarise(
    n_total   = n(),
    n_changed = sum(.pred_class_final != .pred_class_final_cwt, na.rm = TRUE),
    prop_changed = n_changed / n_total
  )

# save 2026-01-16
#write.csv(pred_final_filter, paste0("./outputs/battle_adult_assign_cwt_corrected_", Sys.Date(), ".csv"), row.names = F)
write.csv(pred_final_filter, file = "./outputs/battle_adult_assign_cwt_corrected.csv", row.names = F)
```

# Assignment visualization and check

## Strontium isotopes

Overlay predicted adult Sr profiles on known juvenile baseline Sr profiles

```{r}
# read in full isoscape data for Sr isotope time series model
iso_full_read <- read_csv(here('data','ref_data_for_model_2025-09-16.csv'))

# modify columns
iso_full <- iso_full_read %>% 
  rename(lab_id = Sample_ID) %>% 
  mutate(NAT_LOC = factor(NAT_LOC)) %>% 
  
  # assign real and synthetic
  mutate(type = case_when(
    grepl("Fish", lab_id) ~ "synthetic",
    TRUE ~ "real")) %>% 
  mutate(HvW = case_when(
    NAT_LOC %in% c("CNH", "FEH", "MEH", "NIH", "MOH") ~ "H",
```

# Proportions and Confidence Intervals

Now run a bootstrap to calculate proportions per year with confidence intervals

```{r}
glimpse(pred_final_corrected)

# look at sample sizes per year
pred_final_corrected %>% 
  group_by(year) %>% 
  tally()

# Define posterior columns (natal regions)
source_order

# Set bootstrap parameters
n_boot <- 1000
set.seed(1234)

# Hard proportion (assigned class)
calc_hard_props <- function(data, class_col, levels_vec) {
  table(factor(data[[class_col]], levels = levels_vec)) / nrow(data)
}

# Bootstrap by survey year
boot_prop_hard <- pred_final_corrected %>%
  group_split(year) %>%
  map_dfr(function(df_sy) {
    sy <- unique(df_sy$year)
    
    # --- Hard assignment bootstrap ---
    hard_boot <- replicate(n_boot, {
      df_sample <- df_sy[sample(nrow(df_sy), replace = TRUE), ]
      calc_hard_props(df_sample, ".pred_class_final_cwt", source_order) # remember to use the cwt corrected one!
    }, simplify = "matrix")
    
    hard_df <- as_tibble(t(hard_boot), .name_repair = "minimal") %>%
      setNames(source_order) %>%
      pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "NAT_LOC", values_to = "Proportion") %>%
      group_by(NAT_LOC) %>%
      summarise(
        Mean_Proportion = mean(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
        SE = sd(Proportion, na.rm = TRUE),
        # Lower_95_CI = pmax(0, Mean_Proportion - 1.96 * SE),
        # Upper_95_CI = pmin(1, Mean_Proportion + 1.96 * SE),
        
        # might use a percentile-based approach for small sample sizes like our dataset
        Lower_95_CI = quantile(Proportion, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE),
        Upper_95_CI = quantile(Proportion, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE),
        n = nrow(df_sy),
        
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(year = sy, Assignment_Type = "hard")
    
  })

# Arrange results
boot_prop_hard <- boot_prop_hard %>%
  relocate(year, Assignment_Type, NAT_LOC)

glimpse(boot_prop_hard)

# save as csv file
#write.csv(boot_prop_hard, here('outputs', paste0("prop_boot_", Sys.Date(), ".csv")), row.names = F)
write.csv(boot_prop_hard, here('outputs', "prop_boot.csv"), row.names = F)

```
